root_idea.summary: The root has a primary semantic axis of fire, heat, and exposure to burning, alongside a distinct tradition of worship, invocation, and blessing associated with the same written root.
root_idea.development: The fire-and-heat axis develops into roasting, burning, warming, entering fire, enduring severity, and related object and place nouns. The worship/invocation axis is not represented by the supplied QAC forms and should not be assigned to these Quranic fire-related forms.

senses.definition: To be burned or to undergo the heat of fire.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for undergoing fire and its heat; Quranic contexts include being burned in or by the fire.

senses.definition: To enter and remain in the fire.
senses.usage_conditions: A fire-related construction in which the subject is made to enter, stay, or abide in the fire; this can be rendered as entering, burning in, or being consigned to it.

senses.definition: To cause someone to enter the fire and burn; to burn or consign someone to the fire.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive causative use with a person or other object as the one subjected to the fire.

senses.definition: To cause someone to enter the fire and burn; to cast or consign someone to the fire.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive causative use, with emphasis in some contexts on casting or placing the object into the fire.

senses.definition: To warm oneself by a fire.
senses.usage_conditions: Reflexive or intransitive use for becoming warm through proximity to or use of fire.

senses.definition: One who is burning in or exposed to fire; one undergoing burning.
senses.usage_conditions: Active-participle use in a fire context; the supplied Quranic occurrences include both the singular citation form and its plural realization.

senses.definition: Burning or exposure to the fire.
senses.usage_conditions: A noun denoting the state or experience of being subjected to fire.

senses.definition: Causing entry into fire and burning; burning or consignment to the fire.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun for the causative act or resulting treatment of placing someone or something in fire to be burned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To roast, broil, fry, or burn flesh-meat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive culinary use with flesh-meat as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slander or calumniate someone and thereby cause that person to fall into destruction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical transitive construction, including صَلَيْتُ لِفُلَانٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To soothe, coax, wheedle, cajole, deceive, or outwit someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported lexical use attributed to one authority and distinguished from the slander-and-destruction usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To endure the heat or severity of an affair or war, or to undergo an ordeal by fire or its analogue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May take an affair, war, fire, or another hardship as the source of the heat or trial.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep to or cling to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported additional lexical use; it is not used here as a definition of the Quranic fire-related forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or hit the part of the back called صَلًا.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An exceptional or non-regular usage explicitly marked as extraneous in the lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To warm an object with fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes warming a hand or another object by holding it near the fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To parch, supple, straighten, or otherwise shape wood by turning it over fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a staff, spear-shaft, stick, or branch treated with fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become burned by fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A non-Quranic extension of the Form VIII fire construction, distinct from merely warming oneself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a chameleon, to repair to the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be approachable only with difficulty, especially when a formidable person is inflamed with anger or engaged in battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression based on the literal image of warming oneself at someone’s fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain from seeking a person’s hospitality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A satirical use of the same fire-based idiom.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fuel used to kindle a fire; by extension, fire or the heat of fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical alternatives include what is burned as fuel, the fire itself, and its heat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hand-sized stone or grinding stone used to bruise, pound, or powder perfume or other substances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The stone is the surface or implement used for grinding; the associated implement is separately named مِدْوَكٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use likening the forehead to the grinding stone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rough, rugged strip of elevated ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical description of a rugged strip of highland.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A support for a cooking pot, such as a three-stone hearth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A household implement or structure supporting the cooking vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Roasted, broiled, or fried.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or participial description of food treated by fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dried in the sun, specifically said of a date.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a sun-dried date.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land abounding in the plant called صِلِّيَان.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized environmental noun describing land by its vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A snare or trap set for birds or other creatures.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is مَصَالٍ; the term is also used metaphorically for traps that catch people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The limbs and prominent extremities of a person that become cold at death and are warmed at a fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May refer broadly to the arms, legs, face, and other exposed extremities, or more narrowly to the face and extremities.

cautions: The Mufradat entry supplied is explicitly shared between the QAC roots Slw and Sly; its prayer, invocation, and blessing discussion has therefore not been assigned as a direct meaning of this root's Quranic forms.

The Lane evidence for صَالٍ is explicitly tentative, stating that the interpretation is correct only if the cited reading is accepted; the active-participle sense is retained because the QAC form and the directly corresponding Lane entry are both supplied.

The Quranic Form I fire usages encompass both undergoing the heat of fire and entering or remaining in it; these are kept as separate senses because the lexical evidence explicitly distinguishes the interpretations.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The shared Mufradat row contains extensive prayer-related material that may belong to the neighboring Slw root; it cannot be confidently assigned to Sly from this packet alone.
The interpretation of Lane's صَالٍ as heated, warmed, or burned is attributed without named authority and qualified by 'if this be correct'; it is represented but flagged as tentative.
